# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Monk level 2 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Monk
# level-1 martial chassis baseline to level 2 as chosen input only. It names
# selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values. It
# preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat)
# and the deterministic ability/feat/skill/equipment posture from the level-1
# fixture, adding only the level bump this bounded tranche needs. The
# level-1 monk_bonus_feat choice (Stunning Fist) is carried forward unchanged
# — PF1 also grants monks a SEPARATE bonus feat at 2nd level, but this slice
# deliberately does not add a second choice-slot for it (no fixture data and
# no recognition code exist for a level-2 bonus feat grant; it stays named
# but unproven, unchanged by this widening).
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Monk burden surface: no ki pool, no
# execution of what the recognized bonus feat actually does, no level-2
# bonus feat grant recognition, and no level-3+ progression.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-monk-level2
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:monk:2
ability=strength:13
ability=dexterity:16
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:10
feat=feat:stunning_fist
skill=skill:acrobatics:1
equipment=item:shield:absent
choice=choice:monk_bonus_feat:feat:stunning_fist
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
